events.verdict: Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly places his hand on Washington's (DAL) shoulder but the contact is marginal.
Dort (OKC) and Williams (OKC) both reach in and any contact with Irving (DAL) is marginal. Neither player gets their hand on the ball before the timeout is awarded.
Dort (OKC) steps laterally to re-align alongside of Irving's (DAL) path and the body contact is marginal. Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) then grazes the ball when he reaches in.
Washington (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) drive to the basket.
Play is stopped due to a clock malfunction and Dallas retains possession after the shot clock is reset to 22.
Williams (OKC) commits a take foul on Lively II (DAL).
Hardy (DAL) releases away from Williams (OKC) to receive the pass.
Williams (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Hardy (DAL) and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Hardy (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball to momentarily dislodge it from Mitchell's (OKC) possession.

events.verdict: Marshall's (DAL) pass goes off of Lively II's (DAL) fingertips and out of bounds.
Washington (DAL) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) engage and disengage with one another as Gilgeous-Alexander moves to set the pick.
Williams (OKC) commits a take foul on Washington (DAL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Marshall (DAL) loses his balance on his own accord and not as a result of any contact from Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Hardy (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Dort's (OKC) path and Dort dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Hardy (DAL) is firming up over his left foot and is bracing for the impending contact with Dort (OKC) during the screen, which he absorbs.

Replay review of the foul called on Dort (OKC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Marshall (DAL) loses his balance on his own accord and the contact from Dort is marginal. Dallas retains possession of the ball when play resumes, but there is no foul on the play.
Irving (DAL) establishes the ball in the frontcourt within eight seconds.
As Dort (OKC) briefly gets his hand on the ball, Irving (DAL) leans in and causes the marginal head contact.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) gets both hands on the ball and ties up Irving (DAL). Any contact is incidental and a held ball is correctly called.
Dinwiddie (DAL) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) engage and disengage with one another during the throw-in.
Dinwiddie (DAL) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) crosses the plane of the free throw line before the ball contacts the rim.
Williams (OKC) and Kleber (DAL) battle for position, and get tangled when they reach for the loose ball.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Dort's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
